tools.name: oracle_validate
tools.description: Submit a critical or irreversible action to ORACLE-H for human approval before executing it. The human operator receives a Telegram notification with full context (action, rationale, risk) and can approve or reject with a single tap. ALWAYS use this tool before executing destructive, financial, or irreversible operations. Returns a request_id to poll for the decision via oracle_poll_status.

action.description: Precise technical description of the action you are about to execute (min 15 chars)

rationale.description: Why this action is necessary and why it is the optimal path (min 15 chars)

signature_key.description: Your ORACLE-H agent signature key (Bearer Token). Optional if set at connection level.

financial_amount.description: Financial amount at stake in USD (0 if none)

projected_impact.description: Risk and impact if this action fails or is wrong. Must describe potential damage (min 15 chars)

expires_in_seconds.description: How long to wait for the human response before timing out (default: 300 seconds = 5 minutes)

tools.name: oracle_poll_status
tools.description: Check the current status of a validation request previously submitted via oracle_validate. Poll every 10-15 seconds until status is 'approved' or 'rejected'. If 'expired', the human did not respond in time — abort the action immediately.

signature_key.description: Your ORACLE-H agent signature key (Bearer Token). Optional if set at connection level.
